name: subkit
description: A self-hostable, multi-tenant engine for governed, versioned, AI-assisted workflow execution against connected systems.
author: Mike Bild

scripts.build:engine: rm -rf node_modules/cpu-features && bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts && bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts --compile --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/engine && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/engine
scripts.build:engine:linux-x64: rm -rf node_modules/cpu-features && bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts && bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"${ENGINE_VERSION:-$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')}\"" --outfile dist/engine-linux-x64
scripts.build:sk: bun build apps/sk/src/index.ts --compile --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/sk && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/sk
scripts.build:all: bun run build:engine && bun run build:sk
scripts.test:unit: SKIP_DOCKER=1 bun test apps/engine/src/observability apps/engine/src/logging apps/engine/src/audit apps/engine/src/llm apps/engine/src/workflows apps/engine/src/execution/tests apps/engine/src/test-helpers apps/engine/src/config/__tests__ apps/engine/scripts/__tests__ scripts/__tests__ apps/engine/src/connectors/egress-guard.test.ts apps/engine/src/connectors/discovery/egress-coverage.test.ts apps/engine/src/identity/api-key.test.ts apps/engine/src/identity/portal-token.test.ts apps/engine/src/identity/oidc-discovery.test.ts apps/engine/src/identity/service.test.ts apps/engine/src/api/common-schemas.test.ts apps/engine/src/connectors/templates.test.ts apps/engine/src/connectors/template-binding.test.ts apps/engine/src/connectors/template-enrichment.test.ts apps/engine/src/connectors/recipes.test.ts apps/engine/src/connectors/health.test.ts apps/engine/src/skills/types.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/skill-autoload.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/context-quirk-picker.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/tools/tests apps/engine/src/conversations/tests/save-workflow-draft-rename.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/tests/mcp-tool-policy.test.ts apps/engine/src/sandboxes/quickjs/fail-closed.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/mode-resolver.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/tokens.test.ts apps/sk/src/commands/mcp-servers.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: bun test --max-concurrency=4 --timeout 120000 apps/engine/src/db apps/engine/src/queue apps/engine/src/http apps/engine/src/webhooks apps/engine/src/credentials/oauth2 apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/server-provider.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/mcp-oauth-routes.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/providers/mcp-oauth.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/providers/tests/oidc-safe-redirect.test.ts apps/engine/src/scheduler/tests/mcp-oauth-cleanup.test.ts apps/engine/src/skills/tests/seed.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/recipe-flow.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/destructive-banner.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/skill-autoload-tenant.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/tools/tests/load-skill-audit.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/tests/self-update.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/client/registry.int.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/config-seed.int.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/client/oauth-provider.test.ts apps/engine/src/http/routes/mcp-servers-oauth-roundtrip.int.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/client/pool-needs-auth.test.ts apps/engine/src/operator/health-digest-risk.int.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/tests
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:sk && bun test tests/e2e/
scripts.test:flake: for s in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "--- seed=$s ---"; SUBKIT_DETERMINISTIC_SEED=$s bun run test:unit || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:recipes && bun run audit:invariants && bun run check:docs-refs && bun run check:deps-phantom && bun run check:settings-doc-drift && bun run check:slash-doc-drift && bun run check:config-example-drift && bun run check:embedded-drift && bun run check:llms-txt-drift && bun run check:sk-settings-doc-drift && bun run check:cli-reference-drift && bun run test:determinism && bun test --max-concurrency=1 --timeout 120000 apps/ packages/ scripts/ && bun run verify:ai && bun run build:sk && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check:embedded-drift: bun run db:gen-embedded && git diff --exit-code apps/engine/src/db/migrations/embedded.ts
scripts.check:openapi-drift: bun run gen:openapi-client && git diff --exit-code packages/cli-core/src/engine-api
scripts.check:settings-doc-drift: bun run gen:settings-doc && git diff --exit-code docs/admins/settings-reference.md
scripts.check:slash-doc-drift: bun run gen:slash-doc && git diff --exit-code docs/authors/slash-commands.md
scripts.check:sk-settings-doc-drift: bun run gen:sk-settings-doc && git diff --exit-code docs/authors/settings.md
scripts.check:cli-reference-drift: bun run gen:cli-reference && git diff --exit-code docs/developers/cli-reference.md
scripts.check:llms-txt-drift: bun run gen:llms-txt && git diff --exit-code docs/llms.txt docs/llms-full.txt docs/llms-manifest.json
scripts.check:config-example-drift: bun run gen:config-example && git diff --exit-code subkit.config.example.json
scripts.compose:reset: docker compose down -v && sh scripts/ensure-env.sh && docker compose up -d
